SELECT
  SUM(total_policy_amount) AS total_policy_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', policy_amount_src_10000.effective_date) AS metric_time__day
    , subq_3.has_premium AS policy_amount__has_premium
    , policy_src_10000.policy_number AS policy__policy_number
    , policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Amount AS total_policy_amount
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" policy_amount_src_10000

    SELECT
      Policy_Amount_Identifier AS policy_amount
      , 1 AS has_premium
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" premium_src_10000

  ON
    policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Amount_Identifier = subq_3.policy_amount
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" policy_src_10000
  ON
    policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Identifier = policy_src_10000.Policy_Identifier
) subq_8
WHERE (
  policy__policy_number = 31003000336
) AND (
  policy_amount__has_premium = 1
) AND (
  metric_time__day >= '2019-01-01'
) AND (
  metric_time__day < '2020-01-01'

answer.sql:
WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    claim_amount_identifier AS claim_amount
    , claim_identifier
    , claim_amount AS __loss_payment_amount
    , claim_amount AS __loss_reserve_amount
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" claim_amount_src_10000
)

, sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    catastrophe_identifier
    , claim_identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" claim_src_10000
)

, rss_10007_cte AS (
  SELECT
    catastrophe_name
    , catastrophe_identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."catastrophe" catastrophe_src_10000
)

SELECT
  loss_payment_amount + loss_reserve_amount AS total_loss_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    MAX(subq_21.loss_reserve_amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
    , MAX(subq_35.loss_payment_amount) AS loss_payment_amount
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUM(loss_reserve_amount) AS loss_reserve_amount
    FROM (
      SELECT
        subq_9.has_loss_reserve AS claim_amount__has_loss_reserve
        , subq_15.catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name AS claim_identifier__catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name
        , sma_10002_cte.__loss_reserve_amount AS loss_reserve_amount
      FROM sma_10002_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
          Claim_Amount_Identifier AS claim_amount
          , 1 AS has_loss_reserve
        FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" loss_reserve_src_10000
      ) subq_9
      ON
        sma_10002_cte.claim_amount = subq_9.claim_amount
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
          sma_10001_cte.claim_identifier AS claim_identifier
          , rss_10007_cte.catastrophe_name AS catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name
        FROM sma_10001_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10007_cte
        ON
          sma_10001_cte.catastrophe_identifier = rss_10007_cte.catastrophe_identifier
      ) subq_15
      ON
        sma_10002_cte.claim_identifier = subq_15.claim_identifier
    ) subq_17
    WHERE (
      claim_amount__has_loss_reserve = 1
    ) AND (
      claim_identifier__catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name = 'Fire'
    )
  ) subq_21
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
      SUM(loss_payment_amount) AS loss_payment_amount
    FROM (
      SELECT
        subq_24.has_loss_payment AS claim_amount__has_loss_payment
        , subq_29.catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name AS claim_identifier__catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name
        , sma_10002_cte.__loss_payment_amount AS loss_payment_amount
      FROM sma_10002_cte
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
          Claim_Amount_Identifier AS claim_amount
          , 1 AS has_loss_payment
        FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" loss_payment_src_10000
      ) subq_24
      ON
        sma_10002_cte.claim_amount = subq_24.claim_amount
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
          sma_10001_cte.claim_identifier AS claim_identifier
          , rss_10007_cte.catastrophe_name AS catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name
        FROM sma_10001_cte
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
          rss_10007_cte
        ON
          sma_10001_cte.catastrophe_identifier = rss_10007_cte.catastrophe_identifier
      ) subq_29
      ON
        sma_10002_cte.claim_identifier = subq_29.claim_identifier
    ) subq_31
    WHERE (
      claim_amount__has_loss_payment = 1
    ) AND (
      claim_identifier__catastrophe_identifier__catastrophe_name = 'Fire'
    )
  ) subq_35
) subq_36
